scriptData.label: Chewy-Chewy: lost parts

description.label: Description
description.value:
Your whole head disappears inside fanged jaws or clawed paws. Some chewing and/or mauling later, you are neither whole, hale, hearty nor pretty!

Effects: You lose parts – Amputation (Difficult). Roll 1d10: 1-2 Right ear 3-4 Left ear 5 Nose 6 Right eye 7 Left eye 8-9 1d10 teeth 10 Roll twice Regardless, your Fellowship is reduced by an extra -10 due to the extensive facial scarring.
